invariants.rationale: instantTime is likely required as a meaningful identifier and not expected to be null when invoking this method.
The partitions list should not be null for the method to perform its purpose (even though the body throws a not supported exception).
A List may logically be empty or have elements at the method entry.
If non-null, instantTime is expected to be a non-empty timestamp or identifier.
If partitions is provided, its elements should be non-null partition type instances.
